proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2744.4 *kappāla specifically gives Nepali kapāl “head”, Bihari/Maithili kapār “head, forehead”, Khowar kapál and Torwali kapālo “forehead”. The retained-p branch is distinguished from the weakened and *kabhalla sections; possible interaction with the karpara family is retained.
